title_zh: 把虚构国家的制度标签与主权问题分开

scenario.label_zh: 虚构国家论文中的概念边界
scenario.goal_zh: 辨明制度标签不能代替主权证据并约定按材料分别概括

context_zh: 政治词汇英语练习：成年学生 Cora 与 Tim 阅读教师编写的虚构国家资料，不描述现实国家或时事。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: My paragraph says Borea lost its sovereignty because it had a socialist government.

sentences.speaker: Tim
sentences.text: Where does the case sheet make that connection?

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: It doesn’t. One section describes economic policy, and another describes an agreement giving an outside council authority over the ports.

sentences.speaker: Tim
sentences.text: Then the political label doesn’t explain that agreement by itself.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: I should describe the authority transferred over the ports, not claim that the country lost all control or infer a cause from its political label.

sentences.speaker: Tim
sentences.text: Yes, and keep the economic-policy summary in its own paragraph.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: I’ll separate them and cite the relevant section for each claim.

targets.sense_zh: 国家自主行使权力的主权
